thread:
maya: Ugh, just noticed the npm package we published for the JS SDK only contains .mjs files and the package.json 'exports' points at .cjs. Edge runtime is throwing on import. :facepalm:

sam: Oof. Which package/version? can you paste the file list?

maya: It's 0.9.2-rc1 — here's what `npm pack` shows from the tarball:
```
package/README.md
package/dist/index.mjs
package/dist/index.mjs.map
package/dist/chunk-abc123.mjs
package/package.json
```
No `.cjs` and no `index.cjs` entry, and types are missing (no `index.d.ts`).

lina: That explains it. Our build pipeline used tsup with `format: ["esm"]` for the edge build and `format: ["cjs"]` for node, but the publish step only included the edge output. Probably a publish script bug where `dist/node` was excluded.

sam: Can you share your package.json exports?

maya: Sure: 
```json
{
  "main": "dist/index.cjs",
  "module": "dist/index.mjs",
  "types": "dist/index.d.ts",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "import": "dist/index.mjs",
      "require": "dist/index.cjs"
    }
  }
}
```

jonah: So Node `require()` fails because `dist/index.cjs` doesn't exist. Edge (ESM) works but any consumer using `require()` or bundlers that look at `main` will break. Also sourcemap paths point to `.cjs.map` in some chunks which is wrong.

maya: Yep. We also got an error in our internal canary: `deploy-bot: canary failed — error: Cannot find module 'redwood-js-sdk/dist/index.cjs'`

deploy-bot: Deploy logs attached: https://ci.example.com/builds/98123 — failing step is `node -r source-map-support/register ./test/node-compat.js`

lina: Quick mitigation: update package.json to make `main` and `exports.require` point to `dist/index.mjs` temporarily (so require consumers will at least get something) and republish a patch. But that's hacky — better to rebuild and publish with both formats + types.

sam: Agreed. Action items I suggest: 1) Re-run build with tsup formats `['cjs','esm']` and ensure `dts` plugin produces `index.d.ts`. 2) Fix the publish glob to include `dist/node/**` (we probably have a `.npmignore` or files[] issue). 3) Validate package tarball locally before publish (npm pack + tar -tf). 4) Add a small CI check that installs the package from the registry into a clean node and edge test matrix.

maya: I'll do a republish. For the short term, adding a note to the SDK README and our changelog would help users who hit this. I'll also open a PR to add the pack check to CI.

jonah: For source maps: make sure `tsup` has `sourcemap: true` and `sourcemapExcludeSources: false` (we want proper paths). Also check `tsconfig` `declarationMap` and the dts generator.

lina: One more gotcha — some edge runtimes (Bun/Vercel Edge) require `type: module` or explicit .mjs imports; double-check the ESM entry points are compatible. Keep `exports` granular: "import" -> `dist/edge/index.mjs`, "require" -> `dist/node/index.cjs` so consumers get the right binary for their env.

maya: Republish in progress. I'll post the new tarball list here when done. Thanks for the quick triage :shipit:

sam: Nice. After republish let's tag everyone in the changelog and ping support so they can respond to any user reports.

maya: Update — republished 0.9.2-rc2, `npm pack` shows: 
```
package/dist/node/index.cjs
package/dist/node/index.cjs.map
package/dist/edge/index.mjs
package/dist/edge/index.mjs.map
package/dist/types/index.d.ts
```

maya: Tests: node import/require smoke tests passed locally. Edge (esm) smoke tests also passed on Vercel preview.

lina: Great. Follow up: open a small RFC to standardize the publish layout (edge/node/types + CI validations). Saves this in future.

maya: Filed rfc: https://go.redwood.com/rfc/sdk-publish-layout — contains pack-check CI and tsup config proposal.

jonah: thanks all — let's also add a note in the release checklist: "verify artifact matrix (.mjs, .cjs, .d.ts) and exports field consistency"

sam: Agreed. Closing thread once RFC lands.

maya: Copy — closing after CI PR merged.
